name: Divine Consultation
description: Puts the user in contact with a higher power for guidance — an omen, a truthful answer, or a reply to a direct question.

mechanics.text: On activation, the user receives guidance from an entity beyond their own knowledge — an omen about a course of action, a truthful answer to a posed question, or similar oracular insight. The exact form (a single open question, a yes/no question, an omen roll) varies by source and isn't structured further here.
